title: Original lesson 4 hurt cue
provenance: Newly synthesized for this lesson using two mathematical sine oscillators only; no samples, recordings, network service or third-party media.
method: 180-to-80 Hz descending oscillator, 2.3x overtone, 5ms attack, exponential decay and 15ms edge taper.
reproducibility: Standard-library Python, no random input. Floating-point libm differences may affect least significant PCM bits on another platform.
runtime_requirement: None; the game loads the shipped WAV.
listening_status: Not listened to in this authoring session; synthesis and PCM validation are not real playback evidence.
